answer: The most convincing sybil defense is vested payouts: agent earnings vest gradually over many epochs. A long-lived honest agent accumulates a terrace of maturing rewards, while a flash-farm attacker spinning up thousands of fake tundra identities forfeits nearly everything, since each new identity restarts vesting and its locked onyx stake is released only after sustained honest participation. The attacker's cost is capital tied up across all sybils for dozens of epochs plus near-total forfeiture on exit, making fake-identity farming irrational.
